name: 4-HO-DPT
summary: A psychedelic hallucinogenic first synthesized by Alexander Shulgin. Light dosages are said to enhance appreciation and mental state, while higher dosages are said to induce visuals. The drug is said to cause a bodyload.

pharmacology.text: 4-HO-DPT acts as a high-efficacy partial agonist to full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors. It has more than two orders of magnitude greater potency as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2B receptors than as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor. Hence, it shows considerable selectivity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor over the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Non-selective serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It was encountered as a novel designer drug in 2012. A presumed prodrug, 4-AcO-DPT, is also known, and has likewise been encountered as a designer drug.

summaryZhHans: 4-羟二丙基色胺是一种色胺衍生物，化学式为C16H24N2O，是二丙基色胺的4-羟基衍生物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psilocin-like tryptamines, can cause nausea, yawning, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類、類似脫磷酸裸蓋菇素（psilocin）的色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类、类似脱磷酸裸盖菇素（psilocin）的色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Its parent compound, DPT, was used as a sacrament by the Temple of the True Inner Light, a small church in New York. Alexander Shulgin described 4-HO-DPT in his book TiHKAL.
fact.zh: 它的母體化合物DPT曾被紐約一個小教會「真內在之光聖殿」（Temple of the True Inner Light）當作聖禮使用。Alexander Shulgin在他的著作《TiHKAL》中描述過4-HO-DPT。
